title: Codebase knowledge graph pilot (Graphify) - controlled evaluation before any adoption
applicability_note: D-005-REVIEW and D-005-PILOT are NON-LEDGER applicability sentinels (D-004-PHASE0 precedent). D-005-REVIEW = the capture-session review work: verbatim capture, repository-truth reconciliation, Graphify due diligence from official sources, fit/security/implementation review, alternatives assessment, recommendation. D-005-PILOT = the reserved, not-yet-contracted isolated code-graph pilot (Parts 4-8, 11-13, 18): it is contracted as a ledger task ONLY if the recommendation supports it AND the dependency-security policy permits (or the owner grants an exception per D-005-R022/R023). STANDING rows (lifecycle_events=['always']) bind both phases and any future D-005 work. affected_tasks stays empty until a ledger task is contracted (c5 requires ledger-existing IDs).

owner_approval.decision: Amendment 2 (source-003): owner accepts the M0-T030 decision packet as GO WITH CONDITIONS. The graph is approved as advisory navigation infrastructure with SELECTIVE use (never universal graph-first; the proven benefit is correctness/completeness/fewer false claims, NOT token/time savings). M0-T031 authorized: the four hardening items plus ONLY the minimal selective-routing guidance from the accepted packet. Reserved surfaces (Mission Control map, layer-B graph, six-PRD expansion, NYC Evidence KG, Graphify, automatic Agent Teams injection) remain separate owner decisions. No watcher/Git hook; branch-local graphs; security pipeline untouched.

notes: D-005 is owner-issued (channel owner_message): the owner forwarded a GPT-drafted directive wrapped in their own review instruction; the verbatim source captures BOTH the owner preamble and the GPT text plus the post-block instructions.

OPEN interpretation row D-005-R007: the owner preamble delegates the next-step decision ('doesn't mean that you have to bring me back') while the pack reserves adoption for owner review of the decision packet; recorded reading = review + policy-compliant isolated evaluation autonomous, adoption/integration/merge owner-gated. The owner may correct this via an append-only amendment.

D-005-R022 is expected to bite: the graphifyy package is new; if its latest release is younger than the permitted package-age window, the pilot cannot install it under current policy without an owner-approved exception - the conflict must be reported in the decision packet, never waived silently.
Pack task IDs and graph workstreams never create ledger tasks outside the M<x>-T<n> convention (.claude/rules/expansion-agent-dispatch-hold.md section 3 applies unchanged).
final_reviewed_* are populated at the independent directive re-gate.
